title: Ladder Filter - Band 12 (700 MHz) for UWB (Ultra-Wideband) Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Pierre Dubois

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Ladder Filter filter targeting Band 12 (700 MHz) for UWB (Ultra-Wideband) Filter. The filter is designed on AlN on SiC substrate with a target center frequency of 3527.9 MHz and bandwidth of 229.5 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the UWB (Ultra-Wideband) Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Ladder Filter
- Frequency Band: Band 12 (700 MHz)
- Application: UWB (Ultra-Wideband) Filter
- Substrate: AlN on SiC
- Package: WLP (Wafer Level Package)
- Design Tool: CST Studio Suite 2024
- Design Center: Osaka Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the Ladder Filter design targeting Band 12 (700 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       3527.9 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       229.5 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.5 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 22.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 26.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 27.0 dB
Q Factor:               14827
Temperature Coefficient:-17.2 ppm/°C
Die Size:               0.9 x 0.6 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   3
Electrode Material:     W
Passivation:            SiO2/Si3N4 stack
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open CST Studio Suite 2024 and load the Ladder Filter template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: AlN on SiC with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 3527.9 MHz, BW 229.5 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.5 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (WLP (Wafer Level Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, AlN on SiC).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight N9041B UXA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 10584 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.5 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 22.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 344 MHz offset >= 26.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 6 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 7.6 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +30 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 1000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 94%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-07-09
Devices Tested:         95
Insertion Loss (meas):  2.2 dB
Return Loss (meas):     23.6 dB
Rejection (meas):       29.3 dB
Isolation (meas):       32.0 dB
Q Factor (meas):        14827
Group Delay Variation:  5.0 ns
Power Handling:         +36 dBm
Die Yield:              81.3%

Result Classification:  NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Ladder Filter design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 12 (700 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Rejection at near-band offset requires additional resonator tuning.
d) Simulation-to-measurement correlation was within 3% for all key parameters.
e) Cross-talk between adjacent filter channels was below -55 dB.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
